title: Knowledge Editorial Lead, People Operations
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in editorial strategy, technical writing, knowledge management, or content operations.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience directing external vendor partners, agencies, or distributed writing pools - including defining quality scorecards, leading calibration sessions, and managing throughput Service Level Agreements.
* Experience working in a Content Management System.
* Demonstrated program experience managing large-scale knowledge bases (2,000+ articles) or leading complex content audits, mass restructuring, and migration initiatives.
* Proven track record of creating and enforcing style guides, content taxonomies, and operational documentation standards (e.g., standard operating procedures, job aids, quick-reference guides, decision trees, canned responses).
* Ability to partner with process owners, operations leaders, and legal/compliance teams to establish clear RACI models and streamline review workflows.

**About the job**
-----------------

We are the Editorial and Production hub within People Operations (POps) Content and Knowledge (C+K). We own the ultimate source of truth for Google's global workforce. Our team acts as the master translation and quality lens between complex, localized HR policies and the two frontlines that keep Google moving: our global employees and the human and AI support agents who assist them.Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (known elsewhere as "Human Resources"). We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. Whether recruiting the next Googler, refining our core programs, developing talent, or simply looking for ways to inject some more fun into the lives of our Googlers, we bring a data-driven approach that is reinventing the human resources field.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Author operational style guides, structured standard operating procedure templates, canned response guidelines, and scan-and-act content standards.
* Own the editorial quality rubrics, Quality Audit (QA) sampling gauntlets, and calibration workflows for vendor writers executing updates across the People Operations (POps) knowledge content corpus.
* Partner with process owners to identify redundant, outdated, and trivial (ROT) documentation, establishing data-driven criteria for content retirement and consolidation.
* Lead arbitration and editorial reviews with Global Process Owners (GPOs), Compliance, and Service Delivery leads to resolve conflicting procedural guidance.
* Partner with the Platform Strategy team to ensure content structures align with Content Management System (CMS) taxonomy schemas, and downstream AI retrieval systems.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Controls Projects - Process Development & Documentation Engineer
description:
Want to be part of Energy Transformation, have a meaningful career, work on complex solutions like carbon capture, decarbonization, fast power and grid reconstruction & stabilization that will change the way power is delivered to the world? Come join one of the most formidable design teams in the Power Industry, GEV’s Gas Power Controls team. At GEV Gas Power Controls, we design and implement control solutions that have meaningful impact on people’s lives and enable the transformation of the energy sector. You will be empowered, work in a Scaled Agile Framework environment (SAFe) driving meaningful changes and continuous improvement using Lean principles. You will have a complete life cycle experience from initial concept development through detailed design, implementation, and upgrades, working with over five hundred global engineers with a single purpose; deliver the cleanest, most efficient power to our customers with the Operability needed in today’s dynamic power grid.
  
The Controls Projects - Process Development & Documentation Engineer is responsible for capturing, formalizing, and continuously improving the engineering execution processes used by the HDNU Controls Projects teams. The successful candidate will partner closely with HDNU ITR Solutioning leader, Controls Projects Leaders, Alliance team members, Architects and the Controlled Title Holder (CTH) to document current-state processes, apply Lean methodologies to identify and eliminate waste, and publish standardized, repeatable job aids, checklists, and process guides that drive first-pass yield (FPY), reduce cycle time, and build a culture of execution excellence.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

  
  

* Partner with HDNU ITR Solutioning leader, Controls Projects Leaders, Alliance team members, architects, Controlled Title Holders (CTH), and Controls leadership to validate process documentation for accuracy and applicability.
* Coordinate with CLM administrators and Confluence page owners to maintain platform governance and documentation integrity.
* Present process improvement plans, documentation status, and Lean workout outcomes to team and business leaders.
* Support onboarding of new engineers by ensuring documented job aids and checklists serve as effective training tools, eliminating reliance on informally held process knowledge.
* Drives PI planning & Retrospective for sprint (agile execution methodologies) with Controls Project leaders & RTE on Project execution’s health as part of daily management.
  

  

**Process Documentation & Standardization**

  
  

* Capture and formalize current-state execution processes across all projects and applicable milestones from Project Release through COD, including: CKOM, Hardware & Software design, and delivery.
* Author, publish, and maintain Job Aids, Checklists, and Process Guides for all Project milestones.
* Establish and maintain proper linkage between Confluence and CLM milestone descriptions.
* Reorganize Confluence pages under New Units (Plant Fulfillment) to create a using ISO 9001-2025 standards, logical, navigable, and consistently maintained documentation architecture.
* Update Projects Milestone Checklists and Job Aids and support their pilot use on projects to validate accuracy and usability.
  

  

**Lean Process Improvement**

* Apply Lean tools and methodologies — including Problem Solving Reports (PSR), Gemba Walks, Kaizen Events, 3x5 Why (Root Cause Analysis), Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and daily management practices identifying waste, reducing cycle time, and improving execution quality across HDNU extended scope milestone processes.
* Lead or support VSM Current State and Future State exercises for Project milestone execution, building on the VSM review conducted during the Lean Workout.
  

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline) from an accredited college or university.
* Minimum 6 to 10 years of experience in controls engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical execution role within the power generation industry.
* Strong technical writing skills with demonstrated ability to make the author clear, structured process documentation, job aids, checklists, and work instructions.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  
  

* Demonstrated experience with Gas Turbine, Steam Turbine or DCS Controls environments, including familiarity with milestone-based software execution processes (Alpha, Integration, Comm SW, Charlie, First Fire).
* Demonstrated experience applying Lean methodologies in an engineering or manufacturing environment, including VSM, PSR, Gemba, Kaizen, and root cause analysis tools such as 3x5 Why.
* Familiarity with Confluence (or equivalent engineering knowledge management platforms) and CLM (or equivalent test management/checklist platforms).
* Experience with GE Vernova tools and platforms, including ControlST, AVEVA (IO tools), ACME, Mark Vie, PLM and CLM.
* Experience working in a globally matrixed environment with strong collaboration and cross-functional influence skills.
* Knowledge of agile execution methodologies and experience structuring engineering work as user stories or checklist-based tasks.
* Lean certification (Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher, or equivalent GE Vernova Lean training) is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to independently drive projects to completion with minimal oversight, with a bias for action and continuous improvement.  

* Note:
    
  **To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA.** **For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.**

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Content Writer
description:
At Blackridge Research & Consulting, we seek & value people who can bring energy, enthusiasm, and learning aptitude to the workplace. Your motivation to succeed, thirst for knowledge, and desire to excel at work are a few things we look for, promote, and reward.

As a Content Writer, you will be part of a team working towards executing the company's content marketing initiatives across multiple platforms and formats to increase brand awareness, traffic, engagement, leads, sales, retention, and positive customer behaviour.

**Responsibilities**

* To write and/or edit and/or update engaging and well-researched content for blogs, news articles, news updates, webinars, case studies, eBooks, white papers, websites and microsites, product descriptions, press releases, landing pages, e-mails, social media posts, infographics, presentations, sales collateral, videos, and more under tight deadlines.
* Ensure the accuracy and credibility of the information by verifying sources and citing them appropriately.
* To ensure timely delivery of materials, adhere to an editorial calendar and collaborate with other members of the content production team.
* Use search engine optimization (SEO) strategies in writing to maximize the online visibility of websites in search results.
* Paraphrasing and restructuring written materials.
* Collecting and interpreting data
* Prioritizing tasks, time management, and ensuring timely communication concerning project deliverables.
* Managing multiple tasks at the same time while meeting tight deadlines
* Guiding subordinates in their development by sharing knowledge and ideas.
* Supervising subordinates and ensuring that their work meets quality standards.

**Requirements**

* A minimum of 1 year of experience (unless you think you are already there in terms of skill set)
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in English, Communication Studies, Journalism, media, mass communication or associated field.
* A keen eye for detail and the ability to work with little supervision.
* Excellent writing, spelling, and understanding of grammar.
* Familiarity with web traffic metrics, engagement metrics, and all other general KPIs and KRIs of the website, SEO tools, keyword research tools, etc. (e.g., Google Analytics, Moz and Google Keyword Planner)
* The ability to tell a compelling story using words, images, or audio/video and understand how to create content that draws an audience.
* Effective project management and people skills
* Should be creative, fluent, and passionate about writing fresh, engaging, consistent, and user-friendly content in multiple formats as per the target audience.
* Expertise in Construction and Energy industry would be a plus point
* It is a Work from office job.

We are also accepting applications for this profile from technical content writers, Bloggers  
SEO Writer, Content Marketing Writer, and Content Developer.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Language:

* Hindi (Preferred)
* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Supervisor, Technical Writer
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Supervisor, Technical Writer supports USP’s global Advanced Manufacturing Technologies (AMT) and Resiliency Center work by developing clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate materials for external use. This role translates scientific, technical, and operational information for external audiences and supports alignment between content development and community engagement activities. The Supervisor, Technical Writer collaborates with technical experts, project leads, and communications stakeholders across regions and supervises the Community Engagement Specialist.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Supervisor, Technical Writer has the following responsibilities:

* Develop written content such as articles, briefs, reports, blogs, presentations, case studies, and other communication materials supporting AMT and Supply Chain Solutions initiatives.
* Translate complex scientific, technical, manufacturing, and supply chain information — including technical outlines, interview notes, research findings, meeting summaries, and subject matter expert input — into clear, accurate, and accessible written materials for external audiences.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and project teams to gather information, validate technical accuracy, and incorporate feedback throughout the content development process.
* Support market-facing, educational, conference, and sales enablement materials that communicate USP's global AMT and Resiliency Center expertise, programs, services, and public health mission.
* Edit and refine draft materials to improve clarity, consistency, readability, and audience relevance.
* Apply USP brand standards, messaging priorities, and scientific quality expectations to written materials.
* Supervise the Community Engagement Specialist and support alignment between technical content and community engagement activities.
* Other duties as assigned

**Strategic Value**

* Supports USP's global AMT and Resiliency Center visibility in international and commercial markets by turning internal technical expertise into clear, practical materials for external audiences.
* Strengthens credibility and supports inbound interest by helping USP communicate AMT and Resiliency Center work in a consistent, audience-appropriate way.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

* The successful candidate will demonstrate strong writing and communication skills, along with the ability to work effectively with technical subject matter experts and diverse stakeholders.
* Minimum qualifications include a bachelor's degree in a relevant field and at least four years of related experience in technical writing, scientific communications, content development, or a similar role supporting technical or scientific audiences.
* Experience developing written content such as articles, briefs, white papers, reports, presentations, or similar materials.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical or scientific concepts into content that is clear, accurate, and accessible to broader audiences.
* Experience supporting content development that involves input from multiple subject matter experts and stakeholders, including synthesizing technical feedback and incorporating it into clear, accurate written materials.
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple content assignments and deliver high-quality work within established timelines.
* Self-directed work style with the ability to take ownership of assignments, move work forward with minimal direction, and exercise sound judgment in clarifying priorities when needed.
* Comfort working with ambiguity, including the ability to clarify direction, synthesize incomplete information, and move assignments forward in evolving project environments.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Experience working with U.S.-based teams and stakeholders.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical manufacturing, healthcare, life sciences, supply chain, or other technical subject areas.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

Directly supervises the Community Engagement Specialist.

**Benefits**

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

**Job Category** Publications

**Job Type** Full-Time

title: Technical Writer, Critical Incident Communications
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Program & Project Management

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Salesforce Critical Incident Center Communications Team seeks a Technical Writer with excellent communication and analytical skills to facilitate completion and delivery of customer facing documentation related to unplanned technical incidents.

The role is primarily focused on taking initial drafts of information provided by the Technology and Products division related to incidents and verifying sufficient information is available, then polishing the content and publishing the resulting documentation for customer consumption.

Additionally, follow-up efforts are required to ensure preventative actions listed in the documentation are completed and updated to final versions of the content.This role is for communicators with a solid understanding of the Salesforce technology and products, a passion for customer advocacy, outstanding communication skills, a high level of organization to enable multiple projects under way simultaneously and a focus on Salesforce’s key values of trust and transparency.Responsibilities:

Review initial draft of RCA documentation provided by Technology and Products and review the content for thoroughness and ease of understanding.

Understand complex technical issues and concepts related to critical incidents and translate them into “business-speak” for customer consumption.

Assess contents of RCA to determine if questions are left unanswered, details are unclear, or if the document is likely to address the customer’s needs.

Liaise with Technology and Product experts to clear up questions or doubts resulting from the initial draft in order to ensure customer satisfaction with final results.

Polish the contents in order to create a single “voice” of Salesforce, resulting in RCAs having the same overall flow and style so they read as though written by the same person/team.

Maintain a portfolio of RCAs for cataloging in order to create a searchable library of content that internal teams can use to find incident related information when needed.

Track actions called out in RCAs and communicate with Technology and Product teams to verify actions are being completed in a timeframe outlined in the RCA. Update previously-published RCAs to show progress against noted actions.

Requirements:

4-8 years of experience in areas of incident management or technical writing

Outstanding writing, editing, and verbal communications skills

Understanding and experience in cloud infrastructure and platforms, such as AWS and GCP

Ability to learn and deeply understand technical information and concepts, especially as it relates to database architecture, security, networks, and customer relationship management principles

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, in sometimes high-pressure, or stressful situations, while successfully balancing multiple priorities

Ability to synthesize technical and non-technical details from different teams and determine which information is most relevant for different audiences

Excruciating attention to detail, a commitment to quality, and dogged perseverance to meet deadlines

Ability to work in a self-paced environment, strictly adhering to deadlines

Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, or other related area

Desired Experience and Skills:

Experience with Salesforce platforms. Trailhead Ranger status and Salesforce certifications are a plus

Experience crafting customer-facing communications

Project/program and change management skills

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
